Delete Destination Ip Group
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipDestinationGroups/:ipGroupId

Deletes the destination IP group based on the specified ID. Default destination groups that are automatically created cannot be deleted.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ipGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the group.

Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
SCHEMA
